thread:
zoe: Intake from vendor: they need KMS proxy access + RBAC/export + evidence manifest. They want a 5h window next week. Can infra support?
priya: 5h ok. I'll run RBAC snapshot and exclude CI/service accounts. How do we want to deliver logs? presigned objects or read-only bucket access?
morgan: Presigned objects preferred (fewer IAM principals). Also want an archived copy in evidence-archive for chain-of-custody.
james: KMS: ephemeral role for KMS-proxy limited to 'Decrypt' for test-key alias. TTL 5h. Will wire up key-usage logging to a separate stream.
priya: Snapshot command I'll use:
```
./scripts/rbac-snapshot --output /tmp/rbac-176200.json
sha256sum /tmp/rbac-176200.json > /tmp/rbac-176200.sha256
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-176200.json gs://evidence-exports/assessments/176200/rbac.json
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-176200.sha256 gs://evidence-exports/assessments/176200/
```
zoe: Also need runtime traces showing KV cache hits/evictions. Keep traces small (<15MB).
james: I'll capture two 90s samples (startup + steady-state) focusing on kv_evictions and include a manifest with md5s.
ops-oncall: Ops requirement: presigned links max 30d. We'll mirror to long-term archive (90d) post-window and record checksums. We'll rotate readroom creds immediately after window.
morgan: Triage flow: findings file to SEC ticket, acknowledge within 12h, triage in 24h, patch ETA 5d for P2. Retest hold: reserve morning slot within 72h for P1/P2.
security-bot: Created SEC-3400: "Vendor assessment intake - evidence & KMS window". Checklist added: RBAC snapshot, presigned bundle, ephemeral KMS role, runtime traces, archive mirror, retest hold. Assigned priya and james.
priya: Scheduling dry-run Thursday 2026-04-01 15:00 UTC to validate exports and presigned links. Will post presigned URLs + ephemeral role ARN here after dry-run.
zoe: Thanks. Please add README in bundle describing redactions, fields, and commands used.
morgan: Final action list in this thread: priya -> RBAC snapshot + presigned bundle + dry-run; james -> ephemeral KMS role + traces; ops-oncall -> reserve retest hold + rotation; security-bot -> track SEC-3400. Keep updates here.
